content: परंपर {%a.%} One following the other; परंपराणां भक्षिष्ये वानराणां मृतं मृतम् <ls>Rām. 4. 56. 5</ls>. .²2 Successive, repeated. .{@-रः@} .²1 A great-grandson. .²2 A kind of deer. .{@-रा@} .²1 An uninterrupted series, regular series, succession; महतीयं खल्वनर्थपरंपरा <ls>K. 103</ls>; कर्णपरंपरया ‘from ear to ear, by hear-say’; परंपरया आगम् ‘to be handed down in regular succession’. .²2 A row, line, collection, assemblage (of regular things); तोयान्तर्भास्करालीव रेजे मुनिपरंपरा <ls>Ku. 6. 49</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 5</ls>, <ls n="R. 6.">35</ls>, <ls n="R. 6.">40</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 100</ls>. .²3 Method, order, due arrangement; एवं परंपराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः <ls>Bg. 1. 2</ls>. .²4 Race, family, lineage. .²5 Injury, hurting, killing.
